content.text:
The site matches the approved screenshots again. Both visual tests (desktop and phone) now pass. Two values in `site/css/styles.css` had drifted from Bootstrap's defaults:

- **`small, .small` font size (line 223):** it was `0.438em` and is now `0.875em`. This had shrunk the "SKU: BST-498" text to about half size. It also shortened the page by 10px on phone, which was why the phone test failed on size.
- **`.dropdown-toggle::after` left margin (line 3205):** it was `0.383em` and is now `0.255em`. This had moved the "Shop" dropdown caret about 2px to the right.

The repo has only one commit, so I found these by comparing the screenshots and checking the CSS values against Bootstrap's defaults. I haven't committed anything.

STATUS: DONE
